title: Patient
description: One synthetic patient on the home clinic's roster. data/seed/patients.json (El Dorado, P001-P040) and data/seed/santaclara/patients.json (Santa Clara, P101-P140) are arrays of these. Names and homes never go to Bedrock. Schema v2 adds vi and hbv_tested.

shift.description: Usual shift at the home clinic. 1 = 06:00, 2 = 10:30, 3 = 15:00, 4 = late 19:30.

hours.description: Session length in hours, at most one 4-hour shift block. A session runs from the shift start for this long.

last_session.description: Start of the most recent scheduled session on or before the notice date (it can be later the same day).

home.description: A random point inside a real town. Never a real address.

language.description: The language of the patient's messages. zh is Mandarin, written in Simplified characters. vi is Vietnamese: messages only, no voice note.

hep_b_positive.description: true needs an isolation station at a receiving clinic.

hbv_tested.description: Optional (schema v2). Date of the last hepatitis B test, YYYY-MM-DD. POST /check warns on a transfer or hospital row when it is missing or more than 30 days before the new session.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with an explicit offset, for example 2026-10-26T06:00:00-07:00.
timestamp.title: Timestamp
